headline: MMTC reports 458 physical share re-lodgment requests for September 2026
hook: Routine physical share transfer requests processed
summary: MMTC Limited received 458 requests for the re-lodgment of physical share transfer requests in September 2026. This administrative update follows compliance with SEBI circular guidelines regarding physical shares. The processing of these requests has no material financial impact on the company's earnings or stock performance. Indian retail investors holding physical shares must complete such re-lodgment procedures to dematerialize or transfer holdings.
why_it_matters: No financial impact for retail shareholders.

headline: MMTC and STC may lose their gold import tax edge as a uniform 3 percent GST is weighed
hook: Leveling the playing field on bullion tax
summary: The government is considering a uniform 3 percent GST on all gold imports to eliminate classification disputes and reduce lengthy litigation. Currently, banks and specific nominated agencies must pay the 3 percent tax, while public sector trading firms like MMTC and STC may see changes. The proposal is slated for discussion at the GST Council meeting on October 8. Indian retail investors and bullion traders should watch for shifts in import costs and market competition.
why_it_matters: Tax advantage for state trading firms on gold imports may end.
winners_losers: Private banks gain / MMTC and STC hurt

headline: MMTC Limited submits routine SEBI dematerialisation certificate for Q2 FY27
hook: Routine regulatory filing for MMTC Limited
summary: MMTC Limited has submitted its mandatory compliance certificate to SEBI regarding share dematerialisation for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. The filing is a standard procedural requirement for listed companies under regulatory guidelines. No financial results or business updates were included in this submission. For retail investors, this is a routine administrative disclosure with no impact on share price or company fundamentals.
why_it_matters: Purely administrative compliance with zero impact on stock valuation.
